newsitem.title: USA: TurboChef sees Q3 hurt by delays, shipments.
newsitem.headline: TurboChef sees Q3 hurt by delays, shipments.

text.p: TurboChef Inc said Tuesday that it expects its third quarter earnings to be hurt by about $0.01 per share because of delays in shipments to its largest customer.
The company said its third quarter earnings also will be hurt by higher costs that, in the aggregate, also would amount to about $0.01 per share.
The projected impacts are compared with the previous two quarters, the company said.
The delay in shipments of cooking systems to Whitbread Plc will push potential third quarter revenues and earnings to this year's fourth quarter and the 1997 first quarter.
The company attributed the delay to Whitbread's store-level installations and TurboChef's transition to new contract manufacturing facilities.
TurboChef said the higher costs had been contemplated in its June 1996 prospectus and are needed to execute its long-term growth and product development plans.
TurboChef designs, develops and markets high-speed commercial ovens and other food-service products.
